name: order_lookup
description: Look up order information from DynamoDB. Can retrieve a specific order by customer_id and product_id, or all orders for a customer by customer_id only. Returns order details including status (DELIVERED, SHIPPED, OPENED) and purchase date.

product_id.description: Optional product ID to look up a specific order (e.g., 'P-001'). If omitted, returns all orders for the customer.

name: user_lookup
description: Look up customer information from DynamoDB by customer ID. Returns customer details including name and country code.

name: product_lookup
description: Look up product information from DynamoDB by product ID. Returns product details including name, category, and provider/manufacturer.
